name: Automacao Regulatoria - Envio manual do relatório

parameters.query: WITH candidate AS (SELECT e.delivery_id FROM automacao_miller.email_deliveries e WHERE e.delivery_id = {{ Number($json.body && $json.body.delivery_id || 0) }} AND e.status = 'solicitado' FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE automacao_miller.email_deliveries e SET status = 'enviando', attempt_count = e.attempt_count + 1, execution_id = {{ $execution.id ? String.fromCharCode(39) + String($execution.id).replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), String.fromCharCode(39)+String.fromCharCode(39)) + String.fromCharCode(39) : 'NULL' }} FROM candidate WHERE e.delivery_id = candidate.delivery_id RETURNING e.delivery_id, e.submission_id, e.recipient_emails, e.attempt_count, (SELECT d.report_storage_key FROM automacao_miller.documents d WHERE d.submission_id = e.submission_id) AS report_storage_key, (SELECT d.source_filename FROM automacao_miller.documents d WHERE d.submission_id = e.submission_id) AS source_filename;

parameters.jsCode: if (!$input.all().length) throw new Error('VALIDACAO: entrega não encontrada ou já reivindicada'); const item = $input.first().json; if (!item.report_storage_key || !item.recipient_emails) throw new Error('VALIDACAO: entrega sem relatório ou destinatários'); return items;

parameters.subject: ={{ 'Relatório regulatório - ' + $json.source_filename }}
parameters.message: ={{ 'Relatório de apoio documental gerado. Documento: ' + $json.source_filename + '. Revise o PDF antes de tomar qualquer decisão regulatória.' }}

parameters.query: UPDATE automacao_miller.email_deliveries SET status = 'enviado', sent_at = NOW(), error_message = NULL WHERE delivery_id = {{ Number($('Delivery guard').item.json.delivery_id) }}; UPDATE automacao_miller.documents SET status = 'concluido', current_stage = 'email_enviado', completed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW(), message = NULL WHERE submission_id = {{ String.fromCharCode(39) + String($('Delivery guard').item.json.submission_id).replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), String.fromCharCode(39)+String.fromCharCode(39)) + String.fromCharCode(39) }}; UPDATE automacao_miller.processing_attempts SET status = 'concluido', current_stage = 'email_enviado', finished_at = NOW() WHERE submission_id = {{ String.fromCharCode(39) + String($('Delivery guard').item.json.submission_id).replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), String.fromCharCode(39)+String.fromCharCode(39)) + String.fromCharCode(39) }} AND status = 'aguardando_envio';
